## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** BS-sim assumes 1 contract per trade; real-fills would require scaling by account size (e.g., $25K+ for full headline per OP-20). The P&L values in the result are per-contract equivalents.

2. **Sample bias:** Test period is 2025-Q3 to 2026-Q2 (6 quarters). No explicit IS/OOS split provided in result; walk-forward procedure internal to kitchen_stage1_runner. Overfit risk unknown without IS/OOS comparison.

3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS clarification (result does not specify which quarters are OOS in walk-forward). Quarterly P&L shown but not labeled IS/OOS.

4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (anchor days not tested with real OPRA fills; BS-sim only).

5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Loses on 2/3 J winner days (4/29, 5/01) in BS-sim.
   - Wins on a J loser day (5/07) in BS-sim, contravening OP-16 goal to skip or lose less on losers.
   - Edge_capture (759.21) < OP-16 floor (771) → automatic REJECT if real-fills confirm.
   - Wide P&L negative (-1464.23) indicates losing strategy overall in BS-sim.

6. **Concentration:** top5_pct = 999.0 (artifact of negative total P&L; top 5 days likely positive while total is negative). Exact concentration unverified without day-level P&L sorting.
